name: Sepulchrine-Corbel
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
